summary: Iteration 6 focused on the two new iteration features: (1) Resend real-email attempt with graceful fallback for /api/auth/forgot-password, and (2) POST /api/projects/import — bundle re-import with title-conflict handling, remap, and cross-user data isolation. 12/12 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_features.py PASS. Frontend end-to-end verified with Playwright: admin login → sidebar shows 'Import bundle' below 'Book bundle (.zip)' → non-zip toast → upload same-title bundle → conflict modal (with data-testid, existing title displayed, rename+overwrite+cancel buttons) → rename creates '<title> (imported)' → overwrite (with window.confirm accept) deletes the old project id and keeps the title. Success toast fires ('Imported "X" · N pages · M characters'). Resend attempt confirmed via backend logs: 'resend.exceptions.ValidationError: Invalid `to` field' followed by fallback reset_link in the JSON response — this is the EXPECTED behavior with the onboarding@resend.dev test sender.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/projects/import: remap is correct — page_id_map, char_id_map, history_id_map all applied; relationships whose target is not in the bundle are silently dropped and evolution.page_id is null-coalesced when the reference is orphaned (both verified by test).
server.py: overwrite path cascade-deletes pages/characters/ai_history/projects for the same title before insert — verified end-to-end (old pid vanishes, title preserved).

auth.py forgot_password: if is_email_enabled() and send fails, reset_link is kept in the response (fallback). Behavior verified via test to admin@scribecraft.app and to a fresh @example.com account — both return https link because Resend test sender only delivers to the API-key owner. Correct per spec.

server.py file: 1146 lines — approaching the >700 threshold in the code-review guidelines. Recommend extracting /projects/{id}/bundle (export) and /projects/import (import) into a separate module (e.g. bundle_router.py) for future maintainability. Not blocking.

ImportBundleButton.jsx overwrite uses window.confirm — good safety net; verified Playwright accept path. Consider replacing with an in-app dialog for consistency with the modal aesthetic, but functionality is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the import-bundle e2e + conflict modal flow

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several TEST_-prefixed users, projects, pages, characters, and one AI history entry per bundle; happy-path/overwrite/rename tests cleaned up their own projects. Two TEST_ImpConf_* / TEST_ImpRen_* stragglers may remain (harmless). Frontend flow created TEST_UIFlow_* project and cleaned up both the renamed copy and the overwritten one at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset-link fallback is expected behavior for any recipient except the Resend API-key owner's own verified email — do NOT flag as a bug. Backend log line 'resend.exceptions.ValidationError: Invalid `to` field' during forgot-password calls to arbitrary emails is normal. Import endpoint: filename must end with .zip and file must contain project.json; title-collision returns 409 with detail={code:'title_conflict', existing_title, message}. Frontend: '[data-testid="import-bundle-btn"]' opens hidden '[data-testid="import-bundle-input"]'; modal is '[data-testid="import-conflict-modal"]' with buttons import-conflict-rename-btn / import-conflict-overwrite-btn / import-conflict-cancel-btn. Overwrite uses window.confirm — use page.on('dialog', d.accept). Note: no GET /api/projects/{id} single-item endpoint exists; use the list endpoint for verification (405 on GET one).
